title: 第3章 妾者无休书第4章 断袖之癖
lines: 不知谁道了一句：“倒是奇了，七品之家竟如此粗富，咱们这些破落户反倒不及，就是不知这财从何来……”
又一人轻笑：“俗话说得好‘县官不如现管’，咱们这些立于高处的，不得身清气正？哪象下头这些门户，手握肥差，油水足。”
众人你一言我一语的笑说，话锋越来越不对味。
谢珍身上冷汗直冒，这可干系到她父兄的声誉，忙摆手解释：“众位姐姐想错了，这项圈并非我的物件，是借戴的。”
陆婉儿见状，冷下去的笑意再次扬起，她在意谢容，不想他被谢珍带累，遂接下话，问道：“哦？珍姐儿佩戴的项圈从何得来？”
此时的谢珍哪还记得她母亲的嘱托，急着把戴缨扯出来，替她挡事。
“这青玉项圈是我表姐……”
谢珍意识到自己说漏了嘴，可也晚了。
陆婉儿笑容变淡：“表姐？原来你家还有个表姐，她人呢？今日可来了？”
这一问把谢珍问得更加心慌，磕磕巴巴道：“她……她并未随同……”
谢珍越是遮掩，陆婉儿越是狐疑，在谢珍面上打量，转瞬荡出更清亮的笑语。
“我同珍儿交好，你的表姐就是我的表姐，几时带来让我见一见？”
谢珍知道自己闯了祸，陆婉儿刚才看她的眼神叫她心头发毛。
不及她回答，陆婉儿又道：“过几日我随家人去城外寺庙祈福，不如珍姐儿将那位表姐带上一道？”
谢珍只能应下。
陆婉儿亲昵地携起谢珍的手，带她游转园景，细细问起那位表姑娘的情况。
霞光退去，天边染上深蓝和浅蓝，杂糅一点点的墨色。
用罢晚饭，戴缨带着丫头往后园散步消食，手里打着一把团扇，姿态闲适。
前方拐角处行来一人，微暗的光线中，观得那人身量挺拔，夜风卷起他的衣摆，无声地朝她走来。
谢容这类人，即使看不清面目，凭着那一身丰迥之度，也能肆无忌惮地闯入人心。
在他出现的那一刻，戴缨立住脚，静在那里。
他走到她的面前，清逸的面庞变得清淅。
“你在避我？”
戴缨低下眼，说道：“兄长哪里的话，你我年岁不小，虽为兄妹，却也男女有别。”
话落，砸下一瞬的安静。
谢容逼近一步：“男女有别？你入谢府不就是待嫁于我，将做夫妻的两人，何来男女之别？”
夫妻？戴缨平下的心绪在讥讽中生出隐痛，她一个妾室，连要他一封休书的资格也无，哪来的“妻”
于是抬头看向谢容，一眼就望进了他的眼底，仍是那双复杂难辨的眼眸，叫人永远摸不透他在想什么。
她看着他，没有任何言语，如不是经历一世，怎会想到在她面前举誓的他，狠心将她撇下十年，隔着墙垣，不愿见她一面，直到死……
戴缨的目光太过专注，谢容在怔愕中生出一股莫名的心慌，不明白她为何这样看自己，明明她就站在面前，却隔着好远似的，竟忍不住想以指尖揾一揾她的眼角，让她别这样看自己。
戴缨缓缓低下头，再次抬头时，眼中流绪尽掩，平静如砥。
“夜已晚，小妹这便回了。”
戴缨离开后，小厮上前，不知低声说了什么，谢容听后往另一个方向去了。
content_en:
Someone said something: "It's surprising that the seventh-grade family is so rich, compared to those of us who live in shabby households. I just don't know where this wealth comes from..."
Another person chuckled: "As the saying goes, 'It's better to be in charge than a county official.' How can those of us who stand in high places not be clean and upright? How can we be like those in the lower levels, who are rich in wealth and wealth?"
Everyone laughed at each other's words, and the conversation became increasingly unpleasant.
Xie Zhen broke out in a cold sweat. This was related to the honor of her father and brother. She hurriedly waved her hands and explained: "Sisters, you are wrong. This necklace is not mine, it is a borrowed one."
When Lu Waner saw this, her cold smile rose again. She cared about Xie Rong and didn't want him to be burdened by Xie Zhen, so she continued and asked, "Oh? Where did the collar that Sister Zhen wears come from?"
At this time, Xie Zhen still didn't remember her mother's instructions, so she hurriedly pulled Dai Ying out and blocked her trouble.
"This sapphire necklace is my cousin..."
Xie Zhen realized that she had let slip, but it was too late.
Lu Waner's smile faded: "Cousin? It turns out you have a cousin in your family. Where is she? Is she here today?"
This question made Xie Zhen even more flustered, and she stuttered: "She...she didn't accompany..."
The more Xie Zhen concealed herself, the more suspicious Lu Waner became. She looked at Xie Zhen's face, and suddenly she smiled brighter.
"I have a good relationship with Zhen'er. Your cousin is my cousin. When will you bring her for me to meet?"
Xie Zhen knew that she had gotten into trouble, and the way Lu Waner looked at her just now made her heart tremble.
Before she could answer, Lu Waner added, "In a few days, I will go with my family to a temple outside the city to pray for blessings. How about Sister Zhen bringing that cousin with me?"
Xie Zhen could only agree.
Lu Waner took Xie Zhen's hand affectionately, took her around the garden, and asked her about the cousin in detail.
…
The glow recedes, and the sky is dyed with dark blue and light blue, mixed with a little bit of ink.
After dinner, Dai Ying took the girl for a walk in the back garden to eat, holding a round fan in her hand with a relaxed posture.
There was a person walking around the corner in front of her. In the dim light, she could see that the person was tall and tall. The night wind picked up the hem of his clothes and walked towards her silently.
People like Xie Rong, even if they can't see their faces clearly, can still break into people's hearts unscrupulously with their richness.
The moment he appeared, Dai Ying stood still and stood there quietly.
He walked up to her, and his clear face became clear.
"Are you avoiding me?"
Dai Ying lowered her eyes and said, "Brother, you and I are not young. Although we are brothers and sisters, there are differences between men and women."
As soon as the words fell, there was a moment of silence.
Xie Rong took a step closer: "What's the difference between men and women? Aren't you just going to marry me when you enter Xie's house? How can we be husband and wife?"
Couple? Dai Yingping's heart ached with sarcasm. She was a concubine, and she was not even qualified to ask for a letter of divorce from him. How could she be a "wife"?
So he raised his head to look at Xie Rong, and immediately looked into his eyes. They were still those complicated and difficult-to-discern eyes, making it impossible to figure out what he was thinking.
She looked at him without any words. If she hadn't experienced it all her life, how could she have thought that he had sworn an oath in front of her and cruelly left her for ten years, separated by a wall, and refused to see her until his death...
Dai Ying's eyes were too focused, and Xie Rong felt an inexplicable panic in his astonishment. He didn't understand why she looked at him like this. She was standing in front of him, but he was far away, and he couldn't help but want to touch the corners of her eyes with his fingertips to tell her not to look at him like this.
"Ying Niang..."
Dai Ying slowly lowered her head, and when she raised her head again, all the emotions in her eyes were hidden, and she was as calm as a stone.
"It's late at night, my little sister will be back soon."
After Dai Ying left, the boy stepped forward and whispered something. After hearing this, Xie Rong went in another direction.
title_en: Chapter 3 The Concubine’s Letter Chapter 4 The Fetish of Cutting Sleeves
